proofreading.29: Cyber Hymnal score is a different hymn (Dietrich/Eichhorn 'Abide with Me, I need Thee every day'); the app has Lyte's 'Abide with me! Fast falls the eventide'. The bundled MIDI #29 is the same Eichhorn tune.
proofreading.266: Cyber Hymnal score is a different hymn (Oatman 'Saviour, I will follow Thee'); the app has 'Jesus, I will follow Thee'. The bundled MIDI #266 is the same tune.
proofreading.85: No fitting public-domain score: Ellacombe on the Cyber Hymnal is the 7.6.7.6 D form and the app text is Common Metre Double (56 vs 52 syllables); Holywell and Ruskin are single CM tunes with unknown composer dates. Forest Green stays excluded.
proofreading.198: Two bars in the refrain are 4.5 and 5 beats long in 4/4 in the source, around a fermata and a triplet pickup; I couldn't confirm the intended rhythm from an independent copy.
proofreading.27: Tune-only score (Hanover, no refrain) but the app text has a refrain ('Hallelujah! Thine the glory'), so the app's version uses a different tune.
proofreading.138: Tune-only score (Messiah 77.77 D, no refrain) but the app text has a 35-syllable refrain; doesn't fit.
proofreading.167: Tune-only score (Protection, 11.11.11.11) but the app's verses have a fifth (repeated) line, as sung to Adeste Fideles; doesn't fit.
proofreading.171: Tune-only score (Anatolia 87.87 D, 60 notes) but the app's verses are about 50 syllables; doesn't fit.
proofreading.180: Tune-only score (Bangkok 98.98 D) doesn't fit the app's verse (42 syllables) plus refrain (46).
proofreading.220: Tune-only score (Homeland, Sullivan, 76.76 D, 53 notes) but the app's verses are 66 to 68 syllables; doesn't fit.
proofreading.236: Tune-only score (Hebron LM) but the app's text has the 'loving kindness' repeats (48 syllables per verse) of the Loving-Kindness tune; doesn't fit.
proofreading.240: Tune-only score (Martyrdom, Common Metre) but the app's text is Long Metre ('Behold the Saviour at the door! He gently knocks...'); doesn't fit.
proofreading.244: Tune-only score (Weissinger 56.65, 22 notes) but the app's verses are 25 to 30 syllables; doesn't fit.
proofreading.262: Tune-only score (Kollam 88.88.88.98) doesn't fit the app's verse (26 syllables) plus refrain (31).
proofreading.298: Tune-only score (St. Jude 87.887, 38 notes) but the app's verses are 59 syllables; doesn't fit.
proofreading.80: Music is right, but the refrain's echo words sit on inner-voice notes and the engraved lyrics collide ('trust, let us', 'watch and pray'); not clean enough to ship.
proofreading.276: Music is right, but the refrain's 'seek-ing for me' syllables sit on inner-voice notes and the engraved lyrics overlap; not clean enough to ship.
proofreading.164: Cyber Hymnal score is a different hymn (Asa Hull 'All for Jesus'); the app has 'At the Feet of Jesus'. The bundled MIDI #164 matches the same Hull tune (0.87), so it may be the wrong tune too.
